tier_reason: Tier stays C (first-party-quality gist). Caveat correction from the enricher: the read figure is not a fair comparison either, because UnQLite's unlimited pager cache and close-time auto-commit mean both timed phases run on uncommitted in-memory pages while SQLite commits per INSERT.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Write 1.4x and read figures from the gist both measure UnQLite on uncommitted in-memory pages (auto-commit at unqlite_close, unlimited pager cache) against SQLite with fsync per INSERT; neither is like-for-like. LevelDB, Kyoto Cabinet and GDBM are 2.8-8x faster in the same gist.
corrections.caveats: Hash engine only, no ordered scans; not thread-safe without UNQLITE_ENABLE_THREADS; open multiprocess segfault issue #168; Jx9 memory-safety bugs #172, #173, #176.
